source_title: Making sense of street signs - Business Standard
source_excerpt: The performance of the Indian stock markets is being intensely debated. The benchmark Nifty 50 is down over 12 per cent since the beginning of the year. Expectedly, various aspects of the issue were extensively discussed at the annual Business Standard BFSI Insight Summit, which ended on Wednesday. One of the biggest reasons for the Indian stock markets’ underperformance is relentless selling by foreign portfolio investors (FPIs). At a net level, they sold stocks worth over ₹2.9 trillion so far this year. There are several reasons why FPIs are selling Indian stocks, the biggest being the artificial-intelligence (AI) trade. Some analysts have also pointed out the difficulties that FPIs tend to face in the Indian markets.
